rule: Each 0-framed box with a 5/7 interior has a 9 wall flush against one side and a matching far 9 wall further along. The box slides toward the far wall, pushing the near wall, by min(#5s, gap+1). The number of 5s converted to 7 equals the distance moved. Conversion follows a front-column-first scan order, and existing 7s form a prefix of that order.
scope: Random grids 10..30 per side with 1..4 boxes. Explicit dimensions are honored; num_boxes requests an exact count, while default counts adapt to packing. All four directions, interiors 1..12 per side and wall gaps 0..14 are sampled. Includes all-7 stationary boxes, boxes stopping short and boxes merging their near wall into the far wall. At least one box moves. Canonical 8x8 fixture reconstructed explicitly.
constraints: Near wall spans exactly the box side and is adjacent to it; far wall spans the same range at distance gap+2.
Footprints (box through far wall) of different boxes are separated by at least one background cell, so moved boxes never collide and components stay separate.
Only one side of each box has an adjacent full 9 line.
Lines between near and far walls are background, so gap is unambiguous.
Far wall always lies inside the grid.
Pre-existing 7s are a prefix of the box's scan order.
At least one box has a 5, so the sample is never the identity.
known_limitations: Pre-existing 7s are always a scan-order prefix, as in all fixtures; arbitrary 7 layouts are not generated.
Far walls always match the box span exactly.
Footprints use a margin of 1, so scenes with interleaved or adjacent paths are not produced.
Sampling may raise if an exact requested packing cannot be constructed in 100 scene attempts; no fixed fallback is used.
The fixed 6/9/0/5/7 semantic palette is preserved.
billing: Claude Max CLI; API credentials excluded; no API fallback
